preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= si <= n and 1 <= ti <= n and si != ti for si, ti in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.
There must be exactly n - 1 roads connecting the cities.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of inversions and the sorted list of possible capitals.
The minimum number of inversions must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(capital in range(1, n + 1) for capital in capitals)
postconditions.description: All possible capitals must be valid city indices.
